description: This file defines a CMake function `event_emit` which is used to emit a specific event by name. It manages event handlers, calls each registered handler, supports dynamic addition of handlers during event processing, and respects event cancellation requests. It consolidates the results of all handlers and provides a robust event emission mechanism within a CMake-based build configuration.

methods.name: event_emit
methods.description: Emits a specified event by invoking all its registered handlers in order, managing dynamic handler registration and cancellation logic, and returning the collected results.
